en.Прироста в играх по сравнению с «Высокой: Almost no gain in games over “High performance”, while power draw and heat at idle are noticeably higher. Desktop PCs with good cooling only.

en.Включает стандартную схему «Сбалансирова: Turns on the standard “Balanced” plan recommended by Microsoft and processor makers.
en.Современные процессоры (CPPC/EPP) сами м: Modern processors (CPPC/EPP) raise their clocks instantly under load by themselves, so in games the difference from “High performance” is barely noticeable, while at idle the PC is quieter and more efficient. For single-CCD Ryzen X3D this is AMD's recommendation. If a vendor plan based on Balanced is active (“AMD Ryzen Balanced”, OEM Recommended), the item counts as applied: the plan is already balanced (the vendor's variant) and Lycoris does not replace it. The previous plan is restored on undo.
en.Для Ryzen X3D с двумя CCD используется п: For dual-CCD Ryzen X3D use the “Power plan for Ryzen X3D (2 CCD)” item.
en.На сбалансированной схеме выбирает режим: On the balanced plan, selects the “Best performance” power mode (Settings → System → Power & battery) for when plugged in.
en.Штатный режим Windows 11 — «облегчённая: A standard Windows 11 mode — an “overlay scheme” on top of the balanced plan: Windows shifts processor management and background-process limits toward performance, while the “Balanced” plan itself stays active. Most noticeable on laptops and PCs with vendor settings; on desktops the effect is usually small and idle power draw rises slightly. Only the plugged-in mode changes; the battery mode is not touched. Applied instantly through a documented Windows function (PowerSetUserConfiguredACPowerMode); undo restores the previous mode. Not offered on dual-CCD Ryzen X3D: the mode's compatibility with the AMD 3D V-Cache driver has not been verified.
en.Режим питания «Максимальная эффективност: Power mode “Best power efficiency” when plugged in
en.На сбалансированной схеме выбирает режим: On the balanced plan, selects the “Best power efficiency” power mode for when plugged in: lower clocks and heat under light load, quieter fans.
en.Штатный режим Windows 11 («облегчённая с: A standard Windows 11 mode (an “overlay scheme” on top of the balanced plan): Windows shifts processor management and background-process limits toward saving power. Peak performance is lower — not suitable for games or heavy work. This is not the same as the “quiet” modes of vendor utilities: Lycoris does not touch fan curves or power limits, and the effect depends on the manufacturer — measure it. Only the plugged-in mode changes. Applied instantly (PowerSetUserConfiguredACPowerMode); undo restores the previous mode.
en.Режим питания от батареи — «Максимальная: Power mode on battery — “Best power efficiency”
en.На сбалансированной схеме выбирает для р: On the balanced plan, selects the “Best power efficiency” mode for battery operation: longer battery life, cooler and quieter.
en.То же, что переключатель в Параметрах →: The same as the switch in Settings → System → Power & battery → Power mode (on battery). Performance on battery is lower — games on battery will run slower; nothing changes when plugged in. No policies are used, so the switch in Settings stays available; enabled Battery saver can override the mode. Applied instantly (PowerSetUserConfiguredDCPowerMode); undo restores the previous mode.
en.Только для ноутбуков с Windows 11 на сба: Only for laptops running Windows 11 on the balanced plan, and not for dual-CCD Ryzen X3D. On a desktop PC the item “Power mode “Best power efficiency” when plugged in” does the same.

en.На Ryzen 9 X3D с двумя CCD (7900X3D, 795: On dual-CCD Ryzen 9 X3D (7900X3D, 7950X3D, 9900X3D, 9950X3D) the AMD driver “parks” the frequency CCD during a game only on the balanced plan with Windows Game Mode on; “High performance” and “Ultimate Performance” disable this, and the game loses the 3D-cache advantage. Also check the BIOS: CPPC Dynamic Preferred Cores = Auto/Driver; if a game is not recognized, mark it as a game in Game Bar (Win+G). The previous plan is restored on undo.
en.Только для AMD Ryzen X3D с двумя CCD (79: Only for AMD Ryzen X3D with two CCDs (7900X3D, 7950X3D, 9900X3D, 9950X3D).

en.C-состояния и CPPC продолжают работать,: C-states and CPPC keep working, so the clock is not actually “pinned” — the measurable effect is close to zero, while idle power draw goes up. Only the plugged-in value of the current plan changes; the previous value is restored on undo.
en.Не для процессоров Ryzen X3D: параметр м: Not for Ryzen X3D processors: the setting interferes with the AMD 3D V-Cache driver.

en.При питании от сети Windows перестаёт ус: When plugged in, Windows stops putting idle USB devices to sleep.
en.FPS не меняет. Помогает при пропаданиях: Does not change FPS. Helps with dropouts and wake-up delay of USB DACs, wireless mouse and gamepad dongles, VR headsets. Idle power draw rises slightly. Only the plugged-in value of the current plan changes; the battery mode is not touched. If the Game session option “Power plan” is on, the value is also written to the “High performance” plan the session switches the PC to: otherwise Windows would put USB devices to sleep again during the game — in “High performance” this setting is on by default. Each plan is undone by a separate record.
en.ПК не просыпается ночью по расписанию пр: PC does not wake at night for scheduled programs
en.При питании от сети Windows разрешает бу: When plugged in, Windows allows only important timers (for example, a restart after an update) to wake the computer, not just any program.
en.Обычные таймеры пробуждения ставят лаунч: Ordinary wake timers are set by launchers, updaters, backups and maintenance tasks — the PC turns on at night, makes noise and lights up the room. Night tasks with the “Wake the computer to run this task” flag will now run only when the PC is already on. Devices (mouse, network card) that wake the PC are a separate cause: see the “Sleep and wake” card (Maintenance → Repair & disks → Diagnostics). Only the plugged-in value of the current plan changes.
en.На ПК с Modern Standby поведение таймеро: On PCs with Modern Standby the timer behavior has not been verified.
en.Без турбобуста процессора от сети: No CPU turbo boost when plugged in
en.В текущей схеме питания (от сети) отключ: In the current power plan (plugged in) turns off Turbo Boost / Precision Boost: noticeably lower package power and temperature, quieter fans.
en.Самый сильный штатный рычаг Windows для: The strongest built-in Windows lever for a quiet PC without writing fan curves. The price is a big loss of single-thread performance (tens of percent); CPU-bound games will run slower. The setting is stored in the plan: on a desktop PC the Lycoris game session switches the plan to “High performance”, where boost stays on — only for the duration of the game. A known cure for fans that “spin up” during short load spikes.
en.Не для Ryzen X3D: управление частотами о: Not for Ryzen X3D: frequency control is left to the AMD driver.
en.При питании от сети отключает управление: When plugged in, turns off PCI Express link power management (Link State Power Management).
en.Последовательных измерений FPS нет; возм: There are no consistent FPS measurements; the possible benefit is fewer micro-stutters when the graphics card or NVMe link “wakes up”. If the BIOS controls ASPM itself, Windows ignores this setting. Idle power draw rises slightly.

en.Выполняет powercfg /hibernate off: удаля: Runs powercfg /hibernate off: deletes hiberfil.sys (about 40% of RAM size); Fast Startup is turned off too.
en.Освобождает место на системном диске. Об: Frees up space on the system drive. Regular sleep keeps working, but hybrid sleep (on by default on desktop PCs) stops working: if power is lost during sleep, unsaved work will be lost — Microsoft itself warns about this (KB 920730). A manual alternative if you only need Fast Startup: powercfg /h /type reduced — the file is half the size, but hibernation and hybrid sleep are unavailable then as well. Undo runs powercfg /hibernate on and restores the previous Fast Startup value.
en.Гибернация и быстрый запуск станут недос: Hibernation and Fast Startup will become unavailable. If hybrid sleep is enabled in the current plan (by default on desktop PCs), it will stop working: if power is lost during sleep, unsaved work will be lost (Microsoft, KB 920730); the current hybrid sleep state is recorded in the change log. Not offered on laptops: at critical battery level Windows saves your work through hibernation, and without it unsaved data would be lost.
en.На ноутбуках не предлагается: при разряд: Not offered on laptops: when the battery runs down, Windows saves your work through hibernation.

en.Быстрый запуск сохраняет состояние ядра: Fast Startup saves the kernel state at shutdown. Without it, graphics card and USB “oddities” after power-on go away, dual-boot and access to the disks from other systems work correctly, and uptime is counted honestly. Takes effect from the next shutdown.
